gloss: to be absorbed in; to be engrossed in; to be passionate about

definitions.gloss: to be absorbed in; to be engrossed in; to be passionate about
definitions.explanation: To devote oneself wholeheartedly to an activity, losing awareness of other things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熱中|ねっちゅう}する。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熱中|ねっちゅう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children are engrossed in a game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熱中|ねっちゅう}するあまり、⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was so absorbed in my work that I forgot to eat.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb meaning to become completely absorbed in something. Takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the object of absorption. Composed of ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat/fever) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in the middle of), suggesting being 'in the heat' of an activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熱中|ねっちゅう}する: to be absorbed in work
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熱中|ねっちゅう}する: to be engrossed in a game
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熱中|ねっちゅう}する: to be devoted to research
- {熱中|ねっちゅう}する⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧: so absorbed that...

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}になる→夢中になる：18839_muchuuninaru⟧: to be crazy about — slightly more informal; emphasizes loss of self-awareness
- ⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}する→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧: to immerse oneself — more formal; emphasizes deliberate deep concentration
- はまる: to get hooked on — casual; often used for hobbies, entertainment

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧ (heatstroke) uses the same ⟦{熱中|ねっちゅう}→熱中：00306_necchuu⟧ characters but has a completely different meaning.
